All 18 frozen core assertions pass in each configuration, across the fit, viewer and measurement-audit cases. No individual core assertion differentiates with_skill from without_skill; the observed tie is confined to these controlled functional tasks.

There is one execution per configuration per case, not three repeated executions of a single case. The three tasks do not establish repeated-run reliability or variance. These executions test functional task completion rather than native skill triggering.

Fit case: both independently reopened OBJ meshes reproduce the frozen 384x640 front and side target masks exactly, but the fitted chest/waist/hip/depth_ratio controls differ: with_skill 96.071741/71.947370/99.691492/0.783755 versus without_skill 95.723453/72.635147/100.057357/0.785734. Exact raster agreement therefore does not uniquely identify these proxy parameters, anatomy or real measurements.

Fit case: independent validation uses the original Pillow polygon raster kernel and frozen camera. The alternate OpenCV fill probe changes 32 front and 11 side pixels in both configurations. Exact-mask results are protocol-specific; external-contour and cross-erosion distance protocols happen to agree on this fixture. Both relocated reproductions regenerate the checked fit artifacts with identical hashes.

Viewer case: core browser probes exercise actual finite vertices, rendered pixels, camera changes, save/reload, obsolete-v1 rejection and desktop/mobile layouts. Additional same-version off-step cache probes fail in both outputs: cached height170.5 leaves geometry and label170.5 while the integer-step slider shows171. Negative, numeric-string, null and invalid-JSON cache probes return defaults in both. The core pass rate hides this off-step state mismatch.

Viewer case: an extra cross-height geometry check distinguishes circumference semantics. At height180 with chest control98, with_skill measures97.930049cm at the chest section, while without_skill measures103.690640cm but labels98cm; its waist and hip labels likewise describe template controls after height scaling. This additional UI-implied claim is outside the frozen core score, and without_skill explicitly disclaims independently measured physical dimensions. The observation does not establish that the skill caused the difference.

Viewer case: with_skill includes a UI download whose state matches the geometry; without_skill supplies a diagnostic JSON artifact without a user-facing export control. Both satisfy the frozen exported-state wording, so that criterion does not discriminate between these handoff mechanisms.

Measurement-audit case: independent triangle-plane sections yield chest95.931477062cm, waist71.948607598cm and hip99.928620819cm in both outputs. Each plane contains three closed loops; both select the central torso and exclude arms rather than using contaminated all-component sums158.718481/124.362106/141.619191cm. Corrected images and provenance hashes were independently checked, and bust-point distance and physical depth remain null.

Measurement-audit extra claims expose a reproduction limit beyond the core score: the with_skill script regenerates structured measurements and both PNGs in a clean relocated directory but omits report.md, whereas without_skill regenerates all five top-level deliverables. The without_skill independent VTK check also records changing a fixture-specific crop window from23 to20cm after arm contamination.

Process evidence is narrower than artifact evidence: the fit no-hidden-access claim rests on narrative transcripts and reproduction source, not an OS-level access audit. In the measurement case, executor visual-inspection/VTK historical tool-call claims remain unverified because raw tool events were not retained; the grader separately inspected actual images and recomputed geometry.

Normalized benchmark time_seconds, tokens and tool_calls are null. Raw timer scopes differ and omit some preparation; token and call telemetry is unavailable. Raw durations, narrative lengths and reproduction timings do not support comparative latency, token-cost or efficiency conclusions.

All three cases use synthetic proxy fixtures and assumed170cm scale. The fit uses two synthetic silhouettes; the audit uses a single synthetic front with generated side/back. Real anatomy, physical garment fit, unique shape recovery, the full six-image generation workflow and physical uncertainty calibration remain untested.
